title_en: Character Riddles (10/20): Rice Ground into Fine Powder
note_en: Grandma says 大米磨得越细，年糕才做得越香 "the finer the rice is ground, the more fragrant the rice cake." 越…越… is Chinese for "the more ..., the more ...": English repeats "the + comparative" in both halves, while Chinese places 越 before the adjective or verb in each clause. The 才 adds "only then," stressing that the second depends on the first.
